export_chat_explain.message: Exports this chat as a zip archive: a static HTML viewer that looks like the message list, a plain-text transcript, the raw message data and the media files. Read receipts, full HTML e-mail contents and webxdc app contents are not included.

slothful_welcome_message.message:
🦥 A few things work differently here.

SlothfulChat is an independent fork of Delta Chat — not directly affiliated with it, and not a repackaged copy. The most unusual part: it runs entirely in your web browser. The whole chat core is compiled to WebAssembly, so there is nothing to install and no server that holds your account — your messages, keys and files live in this browser, on this device. On a phone you can still add it to your home screen and use it like any other app.

Because your data lives in the browser, it can also vanish with it: clearing site data, a browser cleanup or private-browsing mode wipes everything. Please export a backup (Settings → Chats → Export Backup) and keep it somewhere safe — backups here are not encrypted, so guard the file like your private key.

This is also a prototyping ground for the developers: features land early, and some of them change or break. If something looks different from Delta Chat, that is usually on purpose.

slothful_welcome_contact_developer.message: Found a bug or something that feels wrong? Tell us directly — New Chat → "Sloth (Slothful.chat Developer)".

slothful_welcome_selfhost.message: And it's yours to run: host your own instance, or fork it and change whatever you like 👉 https://github.com/experintellia/slothfulchat-web

onboarding_intro.message: An experimental Delta Chat fork that runs entirely in your browser and adds plenty of features of its own.

onboarding_usp_encrypted_explain.message: Only you and the people you write to can read your messages. Not the relays, not the bridge.

onboarding_usp_no_phone_explain.message: Get a profile in seconds. No sign-up form, no personal details.

onboarding_usp_no_server_explain.message: Your messages travel over independent relays you choose, and you can use several at once.

onboarding_usp_no_install_explain.message: Chats with anyone on Delta Chat. Your data stays in this browser, so make a backup.

onboarding_bridge_explain.message: Browsers can't talk to mail servers directly, so traffic goes through a bridge. It is encrypted before it gets there; the bridge can't read your messages.

onboarding_bridge_enter_custom.message: Enter the address of your bridge.

onboarding_bridge_invalid.message: Enter a bridge address starting with wss:// or ws://.

onboarding_bridge_down_warning.message: This bridge isn't reachable right now. New profiles need it to connect; a madmail server doesn't.

onboarding_bridge_start_local.message: Start it on this device, then come back:

onboarding_stats_explain.message: Helps us see which steps people get stuck on. No message content, no addresses, no cookies.

onboarding_stats_required.message: Choose whether to share statistics to continue.

onboarding_stats_none.message: This instance collects no usage statistics.

onboarding_new_profile_explain.message: Ready in a few seconds, on up to three relays of your choice.

onboarding_import_backup_explain.message: Restore a profile from a .tar backup file.

onboarding_madmail_explain.message: Connects over plain HTTPS. No bridge needed, but only works with madmail servers that have webimap enabled.

onboarding_scan_explain.message: Got an invite from someone, or a relay's QR code? Scan it to set up a profile with it.

onboarding_scan.message: Scan invite code or relay QR

onboarding_relays_explain.message: Relays carry your messages. Pick 3, so you stay reachable when one is down or blocked.

onboarding_relays_auto_explain.message: Picks good relays for your network automatically. Will become the default.

onboarding_relays_recommend.message: %1$s of %2$s relays picked. Add more so you stay reachable when one is down.

onboarding_relays_only_classic.message: No chatmail relay picked. Phones won't get reliable push notifications; add at least one chatmail relay.

onboarding_relays_not_added.message: Your profile is ready, but these relays couldn't be added. You can add them later in Settings → Relays.

onboarding_policies_explain.message: Your profile is created on each of these relays. Each one has its own privacy policy.

onboarding_policies_classic.message: Classic email: your provider's own terms apply.

onboarding_invite_relays.message: Relays from this invite. You can use them for your profile too:

onboarding_classic_email_new_account.message: Create a new email account just for this. Don't use one you already use for normal email: your regular mail would get mixed into your chats, and deleting chat messages deletes them from the mailbox.

onboarding_classic_up_kept.message: Your own messages aren't deleted automatically.

onboarding_classic_up_unblocked.message: Works where chatmail relays are blocked or unreachable: off-grid, censored networks, too far away.

onboarding_classic_up_other_service.message: Can run on a different service under the hood, like yggmail.

onboarding_classic_up_no_expiry.message: The address doesn't expire when you're inactive; chatmail relays remove unused accounts after a while.

onboarding_classic_up_own_domain.message: Your own domain or server: no dependence on a relay operator.

onboarding_classic_down_cleanup.message: You have to delete old messages yourself; a full mailbox stops new ones arriving.

onboarding_classic_down_push.message: No reliable push notifications on phones, so keep at least one chatmail relay.

onboarding_classic_down_limits.message: Providers cap sending; big groups can hit the daily limit.

onboarding_classic_down_lockout.message: Providers may flag the traffic as spam and lock the account.

onboarding_classic_down_spam.message: Anyone can send it unencrypted mail, so expect spam in contact requests.

onboarding_classic_down_metadata.message: The provider sees who you write to and when (message content stays encrypted).

onboarding_classic_down_setup.message: Setup can need app passwords or turning on IMAP.

onboarding_classic_bridge_warning.message: Your bridge (%1$s) probably only reaches the chatmail relays its operator allows, not your email provider. Pick the bridge on your own device in the bridge step for this.

onboarding_classic_invalid.message: Enter a full email address, like name@provider.example, and its password.

download_may_still_arrive.message: May still be arriving — try again in a few minutes

download_not_on_relay_ask_sender.message: Not found on your relay — ask the sender to send it again

download_not_on_relay_send_again.message: Not found on your relay — send it again from your other device

requests_empty.message: No requests. Chats and group invitations from people you haven't accepted wait here.

thread_reply_needs_quote.message: Reply to a message of this thread to send
